name: sports-coaching
description: Coaches teach a sport one on one or in small groups, paid per session or per hour, in person or online.

description.description: The coaching: what is taught, and how.

price.description: The price per person: per hour, per session, or for a whole course.

sports.description: The sports the coaching is for; football is soccer, and hockey is field hockey.

levels.description: The levels the coaching is for.

ages.description: The ages the coaching is for.

groupSize.description: The most people in one session: 1 for one on one.

minutes.description: How long one session lasts, in minutes.

mode.description: How sessions are held: in person, online, or both.

place.description: Where sessions can be held: a club, or anywhere in the circle the person will go.

hours.description: When sessions can be held, each week.
